title: WhatsApp Integration: Outbound Messaging, Inbound Journals, and Phone Linking
description:
Objectives:
- Outbound: send all assistant messages generated by ConversationsService to users via WhatsApp when they have a linked WhatsApp-enabled phone number.
- Inbound: accept WhatsApp text and audio messages as conversation inputs, including journals, via webhook.
- Linking: enable users to link and verify their WhatsApp number, similar to email linking.

Data model and linking policy:
- Phone number storage mirrors email: it is stored and managed in the authentication provider (Cognito) — not in the profile model (which remains informational only).
- The profile model gains a boolean flag 'whatsappVerified' to indicate that the user has successfully linked/verified WhatsApp for their Cognito phone number.
- Inbound user resolution: map incoming WhatsApp waid to a user via Cognito 'phone_number' attribute.
- Linking flow must ensure Cognito 'phone_number' is set and verified as needed; upon success, set 'whatsappVerified=true' in the profile.

Scope:
- WhatsAppModule with API client, webhook controller, and linking service.
- Event-based outbound integration triggered after conversation flows are stored.
- Inbound webhook validation (Meta signature), mapping to ConversationFlowInputModel (text/audio), media download pipeline, and routing to ConversationsService.
- Phone number linking flow: start/confirm endpoints; persist only 'whatsappVerified' in profile; phone number remains in Cognito.
- Message formatting for WhatsApp (plain text initially, strip/escape HTML; plan for interactive messages later).
- Security, rate limiting, retries, and tests.

Acceptance criteria:
- When an assistant message is stored, a linked user (whatsappVerified=true) with a Cognito phone_number receives the message in WhatsApp within session limits (template-based if needed).
- A user can reply with text or audio; the message is processed by ConversationsService and recorded.
- A user can link their phone via a two-step verification flow; on success, 'whatsappVerified' is set in profile; Cognito holds the phone number.
- Webhook properly validates X-Hub-Signature-256 and supports the challenge verification.
- Documentation 'docs/WHATSAPP_SETUP.md' explains account setup and required credentials.

features.title: WhatsApp module scaffolding and configuration
features.description:
Add a new @src/whatsapp/whatsapp.module.ts  to encapsulate WhatsApp Cloud API integration. Include:
- @src/whatsapp/whatsapp.api.service.ts : wraps Graph API calls (send messages, upload media, fetch media)
- @src/whatsapp/whatsapp.webhook.controller.ts  : GET verification (hub.challenge) and POST inbound events
- @src/whatsapp/whatsapp.webhook.service.ts  : request validation (X-Hub-Signature-256), payload parsing
- Configuration keys in ConfigModule: WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN, WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET, WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN, WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID, optional WHATSAPP_BUSINESS_ID 
- Integrate with Auth/Cognito ( @src/auth/auth.module.ts  ) to resolve users by Cognito 'phone_number' for inbound waid mapping
- Wire module into @src/app.module.ts  (routes under /webhooks/whatsapp)
Acceptance: module compiles, config validated, routes registered, and Cognito lookup abstraction is defined

features.title: NotificationsModule - outbound message delivery via conversations
features.description:
@src/conversations/conversations.service.ts can directly trigger a function in a new NotificationsModule to be created.
The NotificationsModule abstracts away whichever method of notifications the current user has configured to have messages delivered to them. It will depend on the new WhatsappModule and call it if possible.
There's a TODO inside @src/conversations/conversations.service.ts that says 'schedule a whatsapp call with flow.message'.
The service in WhatsappModule does the following when called:
- Verifies that the user has 'whatsappVerified=true' in their profile
- Resolves the destination from Cognito 'phone_number' (do not store phone in the profile)
- Formats message to WhatsApp text and sends via WhatsAppApiService
- Basic error handling and logging
Acceptance: linked users (whatsappVerified=true) who have a Cognito phone_number receive assistant messages on WhatsApp within the 24h session window

features.title: WhatsApp message formatting for assistant outputs
features.description:
Implement formatting adapters to convert assistant HTML messages to WA-friendly text:
- Strip HTML tags (e.g., <b>, <i>) and map to simple asterisks/underscores where helpful
- Preserve bullet lists and line breaks
- Escape special characters as needed
- Optionally render selection options as numbered lists
Acceptance: formatted messages render correctly in WhatsApp clients

features.title: Webhook verification and inbound text handling
features.description:
Add WhatsApp webhook controller endpoints:
- GET verify: respond with hub.challenge when verify_token matches config
- POST inbound: validate X-Hub-Signature-256 with app secret, parse messages
- Resolve user by mapping inbound waid to Cognito 'phone_number'; if user not found or profile.whatsappVerified is false, respond with linking instructions
- On valid users, call ConversationsService.handleInput with text inputs
Acceptance: text messages sent from a linked user (whatsappVerified=true) are ingested and appear in conversation history

features.title: Inbound audio journaling (media download + transcription)
features.description:
Handle inbound audio via webhook:
- Download media via Graph API using media id
- Validate MIME type (ogg/opus, m4a, mp3 if supported)
- Construct a suitable Express.Multer.File-like object and pass to ConversationsService.handleFileInput
- Ensure files are discarded after processing
Acceptance: voice notes from WhatsApp are transcribed and stored as journals via existing flows

features.title: Phone number linking flow: start and confirm
features.description:
Implement a linking flow similar to email linking, aligned with data ownership in Cognito:
- POST /profiles/link/whatsapp/start: accepts phoneE164; ensures/initiates setting Cognito 'phone_number' (and verification) and sends a WhatsApp or SMS code/message for verification
- POST /profiles/link/whatsapp/confirm: accepts code/token; verifies, and on success sets 'whatsappVerified=true' in the profile (phone number remains in Cognito)
- Store status and expiry; handle re-linking
Acceptance: users can link and verify a WhatsApp-enabled phone number; on success, profile.whatsappVerified is true and routing uses Cognito phone_number

features.title: Security and secrets management
features.description:
Implement robust security for inbound webhook:
- Validate X-Hub-Signature-256 with WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET
- Enforce verify token on GET challenge
- Store secrets in env via ConfigModule and support rotation
Acceptance: webhook rejects invalid signatures and only verifies with the correct token

features.title: Retry and outbox handling for outbound sends
features.description:
Add retry with exponential backoff for transient WA API failures, respect rate limits, and optionally implement an outbox pattern:
- Optional DynamoDB outbox table to persist pending send attempts
- Background worker to flush outbox
- Observability logs/metrics
Acceptance: outbound delivers reliably under transient errors without message loss or duplication

features.title: Tests: unit and E2E for WhatsApp integration
features.description:
Add tests for:
- Signature validation and webhook verification
- Outbound listener formatting and send integration
- Inbound text and audio mapping into ConversationsService
- Minimal E2E covering webhook and outbound path with mocks
Acceptance: tests pass and cover core happy paths and error handling

features.title: Templates and 24-hour session window compliance
features.description:
Support business-initiated messages and session windows:
- Create default approved message templates for re-engagement
- Use templates when messaging outside the 24-hour customer service window
- Document template variables and approval process
Acceptance: system can send messages both within and outside the 24-hour window per policy

features.title: Documentation: WHATSAPP_SETUP.md
features.description: Add documentation outlining WhatsApp Cloud API setup, credentials, webhook endpoints, and operational considerations. Acceptance: team can follow the doc to set up a dev/staging account and obtain the required tokens and IDs.

features.title: Add whatsappVerified flag to profile model and API
features.description: Add boolean 'whatsappVerified' to @src/models/profile/UserProfileModel.dto.ts  (default false) and expose via @src/profiles/profiles.controller.ts  DTOs. The phone number remains managed by Cognito (like email we want to show provide it when the user gets the profile but we never store it there - i.e. never ends up in the DB). Update serialization and OpenAPI annotations. Acceptance: field is present in profile responses, defaults to false for existing users, and can be toggled by the linking flow.
